## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (70%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (28%) remains in the 90% conformal set [F1], with positive simulated frozen-section margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 70%, InSitu 28%, Benign 2%, Normal 0% | Favors Invasive; InSitu remains plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage, alpha=0.1) | Cannot exclude InSitu at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability, 64th OOD percentile (12/12 regions, stain degradation 3) [F6] | Typical appearance despite stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones agree on top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (84%–91% similarity) [F5]; contrast InSitu 83% | Nearest neighbors match; InSitu close |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive score (+1.23, value 1.29) [F2]; AI spot check 19/20 · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · Second-strongest score (+0.73, value 1.87) [F3]; AI spot check 18/20 · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (-0.23) adds +0.44 [F4]; spot check 18/20, caption inconsistent · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low confinement (-0.20) adds +0.30; AI spot check 12/20 · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 10) · ↑ invasive · Minor score (+0.18); failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions drops P(invasive) beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); ignore unreliable mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20), normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is high-grade InSitu (28%); contrast case BACH_0117 (InSitu, 83% similarity) differs in pleomorphism and weak duct confinement (12/20).
- Simulated frozen-section and severity-3 stain degradation distort morphology or margin calls (follow-up stains blocked; cell segmentation disabled).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 4, 10**: Verify stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma in peak-risk and pleomorphism areas.
2. **Regions 3, 11**: Check whether atypical cells remain duct-confined or breach basement membrane.
3. **Regions 0–4, 8, 11**: Confirm tumor at superior/lateral (215 um) and inferior/medial (323 um) margins.
